about.title: Skills
about.intro: Here is an overview of my technical skills:

bullets: Development of ML models with PyTorch for multi-channel magnetic image analysis (4-channel TIF: Bx, By, Bz, Norm).
Results: pipe presence classification Accuracy 93%, Recall 96%; magnetic width regression MAE 0.82 m.
Handling heterogeneous image sizes (150×150 to 4000×3750): normalization, padding/patching, data augmentation.
Production-ready delivery: model (.pth) + reproducible inference.py script.

bichette.title: Bichette Thomas — SaaS Web Application
bichette.description: Modular FastAPI backend (auth, products, orders, booking, payments, chat). PostgreSQL 16, JWT, Redis, Stripe + webhooks. LLM: Claude API with dynamic context and SSE streaming. Docker + Nginx + CI/CD GitHub Actions.

rag.title: RAG Platform — AI Assistant
rag.description: Full RAG pipeline: ingestion, chunking, embeddings and vector search (ChromaDB). FastAPI with conversation management and PostgreSQL storage.

sentiment.title: Sentiment Analysis (PyTorch)
sentiment.description: Binary sentiment classification on 100K tweets (Sentiment140) with PyTorch: comparison of simple NN, GRU and bidirectional LSTM. Full NLP preprocessing. Best model: Bidirectional GRU.

smishing.title: Smishing Data Collection
smishing.description: Low-cost infrastructure for collecting and analyzing suspicious SMS to detect smishing cases.

ecommerce.title: Online Store — C# ASP.NET
ecommerce.description: E-commerce built with C# and ASP.NET: registration/authentication, profile management, product listing/filtering, cart, Stripe payments and invoices. (Pair project)
